checks.name: operational_records
checks.observed: Parsed seed tables; checked unique keys, foreign keys, one active assignment per shipment, mass conservation, driver links, synthetic excursion-budget inheritance and no cold cargo initially assigned to a truck lacking reefer equipment.

checks.name: rescue_options
checks.observed: Recomputed route pricing, arrival/restoration/delivery times, duty budgets, reefer/capacity eligibility and receiving-slot coverage from fixture fields.

checks.name: independent_fixture_replay
checks.observed: Loaded fixture inputs into a temporary independent Python calculation; selected feasible options using the documented rule. This does not exercise ADK, Gemini, critic extraction or an HTTP carrier service.

checks.name: sensor_traces
checks.observed: Parsed CSV observations; checked timestamp order/intervals, quality labels, finite values, independent linear fit, known exposure subtraction, uncertainty and exclusion of hypothetical future recovery data.

checks.name: media
checks.observed: Decoded every collected image; visually inspected original-photo contact sheet and roadside thumbnail. Decoded all WAV PCM frames, checked format/duration and non-silent signal. Extracted PDF text and matched canonical identifiers, mass, recipient and missing-receipt fields. Verified per-asset SHA-256 digests.

checks.name: references
checks.observed: Parsed the source catalog; checked required metadata and local copies. Verified CDC PDF size/hash, decoded its 41 pages and extracted substantive toolkit text. Public URL-opening evidence and failed retrievals are recorded by the collector; no account-specific API access was exercised.

checks.name: local_links
checks.observed: Resolved fixture file paths, local-copy links and JSON Pointer incident references.
